need: Redesign Global Chat as one coherent end-to-end customer journey, from entry and orientation through conversation participation, recovery, and responsive continuation.
negativeBoundary: Do not merge Global Chat with the Learn AI assistant, narrow the work to lesson or challenge chat, or treat the request as a cosmetic restyle of one isolated screen.
acceptanceCriteria: The journey makes the next useful action clear from entry through active conversation.
Global Chat remains visibly distinct from the Learn AI assistant and other course-learning help flows.
The complete page and state set covers discovery, orientation, reading, participation, recovery, and responsive behavior.
The delivered interface is proven with deterministic states, UI quality checks, and real-browser acceptance across declared viewports.

accepts: A Global Chat redesign organized around the user's complete journey.
A course-community conversation experience with clear entry, orientation, participation, and recovery.
rejects: A lesson-only or challenge-only chat experience.
Conflating Global Chat with AI translation or explanation inside Learn.
A visual-only restyle that leaves the journey and state model unchanged.
